name: SFXRunScript

name: SFXCmdDuty

name: SFXCmdLoopStart
comment: $3x nn: wSFXChLoopCount = nn; wSFXChLoopPtr = the next command

name: SFXCmdLoopEnd
comment: $4x: decrements wSFXChLoopCount and jumps back to wSFXChLoopPtr until it is 0

name: SFXCmdSlide
comment: $5x nn: wSFXChSlide = nn (signed frequency step per frame; NR43 step on the noise channel)

name: SFXCmdWait
comment: $6x nn: applies the slide once then waits nn frames (wSFXChWait); ends the frame

name: SFXApplySlide

name: SFXApplyNoiseSlide

name: SFXCmdWave

name: SFXCmdBallPitch

name: SFXCmdEnd
